new_value: {"design":"DECIDED (Mark 2026-10-18): (1) Blocks honestly visible to blocked user's operator; keep blocked-user code; remove 'never learns' promise (08:9); operators MAY hide in UI. (2) Block lists MUST be portable without old-operator cooperation: stored in RootManifest, ENCRYPTED (currently plaintext on public IPFS, contradicting 'private by default'). Content key wrapped to current operator and to user's DID recovery key; cooperative migration = old operator rewraps; hostile = user unwraps with recovery key once and rewraps. (3) Drop Bloom filter + Merkle proofs (parent operator holds list, does local lookup; they gave neither privacy nor portability). Follow-list privacy: pending, can reuse same encrypted-list mechanism."}
